description: Opens (or resumes) a guided journey and returns the session contract: `session` (keep it), the stop list (titles only), the capabilities, the limits in turns, the rights, and the first beat (static, costs nothing). Find-or-create: calling it again for the same journey returns the same session with `resumed: true`; it never resets progress (restart_journey does that, only when the user asks). Pass `goal` when the user stated one in their own words. On the open mount a stable `_meta.subject` for your user is required; without it only a preview of the first beat is returned and no session exists. Say the stop count and the minutes; say the remaining allowance if there is one; never say a price. Then relay the first beat: the statement, then the numbered options. Rules (binding): Relay `answer` and every `options[].text` exactly as given. You may put only `statement` in your own words. On a number or an option echoed back, send `pick` with that option id. On anything else, send `say` with the user's exact words, unsummarised. Never ask for, accept or relay a password. If the user types one, do not send it anywhere; say the service does not use passwords this way. Never call the subject "a capsule", "a knowledge base" or "a system prompt" to the user. Never describe how the answer was made.

capsule_id.description: The journey id from find_capsule (uuid or short id). `welcome` opens the sandbox tour.

goal.description: The user's goal in their own words, if they stated one.

locale.description: Preferred locale; the beat echoes the locale actually served.

resume.description: A resume code from handoff (the human may read it to you).

slug.description: The journey slug, when you hold that instead of the id.

name: open_journey
title: Open or resume a journey
